subject: Class 507 in Merseyrail Good Communications livery (grey background), as withdrawn 2024-11-28
method: Side elevation from the Unisouth-template Merseyrail 507 diagram, horizontal and vertical calibrated separately (vertical from two photo heights); door positions cross-checked with 1D projective fits on 508112 and 508108; face measured on the head-on 507014 photo (416.7 px/m), checked against 507009 and 508141; colours sampled.

trace.calibration.diagram.x: Class_507_Merseyrail_New_Diagram.png (Unisouth 313 template): DM drawn 75..1524 px = published 19.800 m -> 73.2 px/m; doors 499 px apart on both cars. The TSO is drawn 1581..2957 (1376 px = 18.8 m) for a published 19.92 m, so its features are placed from its centre (2269 px).
trace.calibration.diagram.y: Vertical: the diagram's roof is drawn low (37 px above the cantrail line instead of ~0.6 m), so heights are taken from rail (row 345) at 93.4 px/m, fixed by two photo heights: the orange cantrail line (row 67) = 2.97 m and the bodyside bottom (row 265) = 0.857 m. Rail at 345 then falls out (0.857 x 93.4 + 265 = 345), a check. Above the cantrail the diagram is not used.
trace.calibration.face: 507014 Hoylake (3840 px, head-on, camera at about pod height): face 1284..2459 px = 2.82 m -> 416.7 px/m, square pixels (marker lenses 69 x 68 px). Heights from the valance bottom (row 1700) taken as 0.78 m: that puts the dome crown at 3.545 m equivalent, 4 cm under the published 3.582, which is the crown's set-back seen from below. The higher Southsea_Matt photos (507009 Orrell Park, 508141) read the lower front 6-10 cm taller relative to the band: from above they see the top of the protruding valance and into the slots, so the low camera is used.
trace.heights.bottom: Diagram body bottom row 265 -> 0.857 m; photo 508108/507009 cab corner: the grey side ends about 0.08 m above the yellow valance bottom (0.78).
trace.heights.cantrail: Face outline 507014: half-width 1.33 m at 3.28 m, 1.01 at 3.42, 0.78 at 3.47, 0.46 at 3.52; so the sides stay nearly upright to ~3.26 and the roof arcs from there. Old model 3.27 (kept by chance); the orange line is lower, at 2.97-3.0.
trace.heights.window: Saloon glass 1.70-2.70. The diagram gave 1.82-2.655 (frames 1.767-2.709); the window pair (507 match-p009a) shows the photo's glass much taller than the render's, and the p112 camera puts three glass bottoms at 1.75 / 1.69 / 1.70 and (with the tops free, first solve) the tops at 2.70-2.72; p108 reads ~1.0 m of glass by its door. The cab fixed window shares the height and so now draws taller than its photo (~1.95-2.61).
trace.wheelbase: Diagram wheel centres 147.5/337.5 px -> 2.596 m. wheel: 0.84 kept (diagram wheels 60 px = 0.82 m).
trace.cab.bogies: Front bogie from the diagram (wheels 147.5/337.5 -> 2.288 m); rear = front + published bogie centres 14.170 m (the diagram draws 16.523, 6.5 cm off).
trace.next.bogies: Published bogie centres 14.170 m, centred on the 19.92 m TSO (the diagram's trailer is compressed: 12.27 m between its bogies).
trace.cab.doors[0]: Cab door outline 168..230 px -> 1.27..2.117 m (w 0.847), droplight 182..216 px, span rows 73..265.
trace.cab.windows[0]: Fixed cab window ahead of the cab door, 132..161 px -> 0.779..1.175 m; order (window then door, from the front) confirmed on 508138 Walton and 507010 Sandhills.
trace.doors.x: Diagram leaf centres 586.5/1085.5 px -> 6.988/13.805 m on the DM; TSO 6.545/13.368 from its centre. Camera matches (2026-10-06, door 1's seal corners held out, 3-6 cm): door-1 seal centre 7.06 (507009 p009a), 7.01 (507009 p009t), 7.11 (508112 p112), 7.02 (508138 p138w), mean 7.05; door 2 13.77 / 13.82 / 13.84 / 13.85 against the diagram's 13.808 (kept). Door 1 moved from 6.989 to 7.05; the old 1D fits' 6.56 is ruled out. The TSO's doors are not seen in any match and keep the diagram.
trace.doors.w: 1.72 m opening: the orange seal's outer edges read 1.81 / 1.83 (p009a), 1.78 / 1.89 (p009t), 1.83 / 1.78 (p112), 1.86 / 1.82 (p138w) in the camera matches, mean 1.82, less the 0.05 m seal each side; the diagram draws 1.71 m of leaf. The published clear opening 1.288 m is between the leaves' edges. Was 1.54 from 1D fits (rms 7-12 cm).
trace.doors.panes: Leaf windows 12.5..51.5 px from the door centre on a 62.5 px half door (diagram), scaled to w 1.72.
trace.windows: Diagram glass+frame 120 px = 1.64 m each. Camera matches (2026-10-06) read every saloon window's dark glass ~0.1 m inside each frame edge (p108: 1.26 / 1.40 / 1.47 / 1.40 / 1.55 m wide), and window 1 (behind the cab door) narrower than the rest: its front edge reads 0.31 (p108) and 0.26-0.35 (p112) behind the diagram's 3.799 where the others' front edges read 0.01-0.19 behind theirs; its centre reads +0.10 / +0.14 / -0.05 / 0.00 / +0.18 on p108 / p112 / p138w / p009t / p009a. Window 1's front edge moved to 3.95 (the old 1D fits also read it 0.2 m narrower); the others keep the diagram.
trace.under: Diagram underframe boxes 506..1135 px (DM), 1969..2568 (TSO, from its centre).
trace.nose.profile: Flat vertical face from the valance (0.78) to the band top (3.26); the dome above estimated from the face outline widths and the side photos (no side-on cab photo): crown 3.582 reached ~0.5 m back. Not measured; a camera match should check it.
trace.form: Width 2.82 published; tumblehome 0.08 from the face outline (1.41 -> 1.33 at 3.28 m); setback 0.12 = the corner radius, from the 0.10-0.12 m of yellow seen wrapping each corner on 507014; glazing in black riveted rubber gaskets (screens) and black-framed bodyside windows.
trace.face.dark[0]: Black window band 1327..2424 px wide (+-1.32 m), rows 1213..665 -> 1.949..3.264 m; top corners rounded ~0.10 m.
trace.face.dark[1..2]: Dark slots under the pods: 507014 row 1610, left 1343..1574 px, right 2066..2390 px (the left one has a yellow box at its inner end), cols 1500/2200 rows 1597..1624 -> 0.97..1.03 m.
trace.face.dark[3..5]: Gangway frame strips 1712..1748 and 1997..2036 px and a second bar 2043..2063 px on the right only (rows 1213..1650).
trace.face.gangway: Gangway door yellow from 0.958 up to the band's bottom (1.949) only: above it the door is black round its window, part of the band (p014, p009a, p108); was drawn yellow to 2.873, which made the band read as a thick black frame round a yellow door.
trace.face.lights[0]: Pod: tilted egg from the outboard end (1338,1430 px) to the inboard tip (1633,1545 px): 0.76 m long, 21 deg, 0.336 m across at the wide end. Headlamp lens 1389..1488 px centred (1438.5,1468), r 0.12 incl. bezel; tail LED centred (1551,1522.5), r 0.095. Head outboard and higher, tail inboard and lower, on both pods (507014, 507009, 508141, 508108, 508120).
trace.face.lights[1]: Marker lenses 1777..1846 and 1918..1985 px, rows 657..728: r 0.083, centres +-0.168 m (spacing 140 px; 507009 gives 0.328, 508141 0.355), 3.199 m; tops touch the orange line.
trace.face.lights[2]: Roof lamp: LED cluster on a yellow plinth at the dome's top centre, rows 552..640 -> centre 3.427 m, housing r 0.09 incl. ring (507009: 3.447); the LED disc drawn r 0.06 (measured ~0.065: r 0.075 runs outside the housing once laid on the curved dome).
trace.face.shapes: Orange line rows 652..665 across the band top (3.264..3.295), and down both band sides (1315..1325 px) to row 772 (3.0 m), where it turns onto the bodyside. Destination boxes: left blank 1340..1674 x 688..815 px, right 2094..2390 x 672..811 with the amber dot-matrix strip 2137..2344 x 711..760.
trace.face.number: 507014 digits 2151..2368 px x 1258..1318 px -> centre m 0.93, y 1.769, height 0.144; rendered unit 507009 (December 2022). Positive m = right as seen head-on (as the 320's number).
trace.face.wipers: One wiper, right screen only (507014, 507009, 508141): pivot at the screen's top outer corner (2266,804 px), blade hanging down and inboard to (2170,986).
trace.livery.ME.body: 508108 Meols grey bodyside #9A9A99 raw, #9CA0A6 against the platform-edge white; 507009 Orrell #A5AD97 against a marker lens (weak neutral). Grey with a blue cast in every overcast photo.
trace.livery.ME.yellow: Face, doors and gangway one yellow: 507014 gangway door in sun #E6C03A (no neutral on the face; the Southsea_Matt overcast photos render it orange-yellow #C29005-#C98201 raw).
trace.livery.ME.orange: Orange: 507014 #F48A50..#FE8D3B in sun, 507009 #BD3E08 raw; #F07A2E. Bodyside line at 2.97..3.0 m.
trace.livery.ME.lowline: Thin yellow line low along the bodyside, 1.115..1.165 m: at the cab corner 507009 (with the band-to-valance scale) 1.10..1.16, 508108 1.14 +- 0.03.
trace.livery.ME.doorEdges: Orange-red seal round each passenger door opening, 0.05 m wide down both sides, and across the top up to 2.956: the camera matches read the seal's held-out outer top corners at 2.91-2.99 (mean 2.96) against the opening top 2.891, with a hairline of body colour under the orange line (2.97) (507009, 508108, 508112, 508138).
trace.livery.ME.branding: Front only: the Merseyrail M roundel (dark grey disc #4D5B58 balanced / #828380 in sun, orange-yellow M), disc 1431..1617 px x 1214..1401 px on 507014 -> centre m -0.834 (u 0.204), y 1.716 m, height 0.449 m. No bodyside logo on the grey or yellow Good Communications units (507009, 508108, 508120, 507010). Needs logos/ME-roundel.svg (see notes).
trace.livery.ME.artwork: The Good Communications line-art (Liverpool landmarks, 'made by Merseyrail' slogans, unit-specific: 508120 has a yellow wave on the cab side) is not modelled.
trace.face.handedness: Every asymmetric front feature was measured with m positive to the right as seen from the front (507014 p014), but the pipeline's m is +Y, the train's right, which is left as seen: the first close render put the number left and the roundel right, against every photo (p014, p009a, p009t, p108, p112, p138w: roundel left, number, destination display and wiper right). 2026-10-06: the non-mirrored dark parts, shapes, number and wiper negated and the roundel's u taken as 1 - u.
trace.face.markers: Marker lenses r 0.075 (as large as the 0.083 housing allows once filleted): on p009a, p009t and p014 the white disc fills the whole housing; the render's 0.07 lens in a black ring read small in the face pairs.
trace.face.gangwaySides: The dark strips beside the gangway door narrowed to 0.05 m (were 0.087 / 0.094): the face pairs on p009a and p009t show thin dark seams, and the render's strips read as a heavy black frame round the door.
